summary: `task_inputs.py --epic` now bounds a Product Owner writer task right after `backlog_compile.py stub-story`. A writer task's backlog closure lists the untouched placeholders that `stub-epic` and `stub-story` write in `check.scaffold_findings` instead of refusing the epic, so the new story and test plan resolve into the write scope. Every other source, link, dependency or cycle finding still fails, a scenario left unclassified once no stub coverage row remains still fails, and reviewer and other read-only closures, `backlog_review_inputs.py` included, still require complete sources. `backlog_compile.py check` and approval report the same findings as before.
